title: Public-sector union meeting announces possible future demonstrations
reason: The opened January article describes union planning and a threat/proposal for future weekly demonstrations or industrial action; it does not establish any demonstration executed in February or a February onset.
notes: The Patriot On Sunday labels the story 2021-01-03 and says civil servants gathered in Gaborone and Francistown on Thursday; the exact meeting date is unstated (the article context suggests late December 2020, but this is not treated as certain). A speaker refers to “multitudes” in the Francistown civic-centre hall without a count. The planning meeting is not automatically a public protest episode. Q027-Q030 follow-up searches did not identify an executed February demonstration; that negative result is limited to open-web discovery and is not evidence that none occurred.

title: Kgatleng land-use dispute and unspecified kgotla discussions
reason: The retrospective story dates a land-board moratorium to February 2021, but does not date or count the unspecified kgotla meetings or identify them as protest assemblies; its 5 March follow-up is a letter by six people, not a public gathering.
notes: This is a screening exclusion, not evidence that no related meeting occurred. The source describes a policy dispute and references kgotla discussions without event-level date, public character, attendance, organizer or demand delivery. Keep the lead open as a source gap; do not use the 2023 article date as event date or the “hundreds” of affected owners as assembly turnout.

title: Botswana Teachers Union meeting and school-closure advocacy
reason: The source describes an interview after a meeting with BTU regional organisers and an existing union-government policy engagement; it reports no public protest assembly, attendance or strike.
notes: The union advocated closing schools for 14 days after the Ministry and COVID-19 task force rejected its plea. This is labor/education policy advocacy and an internal organizers’ meeting, not a coded February mass mobilization. The event/location/date metadata say Interview, Maun, 21 Feb 2021.
